mapper.select: SELECT no,title,name as instructor,star,student_count,content,thumbnail FROM course c JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE no=#{course_no}

SELECT no,e.member_id,name,rating,review,like_count,TO_CHAR(e.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as dbday, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM course_evaluation_like cel WHERE cel.member_id=#{member_id} AND cel.ce_no=e.no ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as liked FROM course_evaluation e JOIN member m ON e.member_id=m.member_id WHERE course_no=#{course_no} ORDER BY e.regdate DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE course_evaluation SET like_count=like_count+1 WHERE no=#{ce_no}
UPDATE course_evaluation SET like_count=like_count-1 WHERE no=#{ce_no}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM course_evaluation_like WHERE ce_no=#{ce_no} AND member_id=#{member_id}
mapper.select: SELECT title,m.name as instructor,star,thumbnail FROM course c JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE no=#{course_no}
